key_facts: REVIEWED Fri Sep 11 (T+1d to Sat Sep 12 Venice awards ceremony; local AFP/Al Jazeera/Hindustan Times/Khaleej Times/NDTV Sep 10-11 + Exa Sep 11; UNCHANGED at Woman Unknown 0.12, NAZA 0.11, Possible Love 0.09, Look Back 0.08, Wild Horse Nine 0.07; sum=0.47, outside=0.53): Final pre-ceremony coverage continues to be dominated by NAZA (Yuval Abraham & Rachel Szor Gaza documentary, sole doc in competition, record 24.5-25 min standing ovation on Thu Sep 10, Golden Lion frontrunner with 2025 Hind Rajab director Kaouther Ben Hania on Maggie Gyllenhaal's jury). Under Venice award-exclusivity rules (where documentaries cannot win acting/screenplay and 2025 doc Below the Clouds took SJP while Hind Rajab took GJP), NAZA retains a strong ~0.11 SJP share alongside ~45% Golden Lion / ~28% GJP, while Woman Unknown (#3 Int'l critics 3.80, sole solo female director) holds #1 SJP slot at 0.12, ahead of Possible Love (#1 Int'l 4.55) 0.09, Look Back (#2 Italian 4.04) 0.08, and Wild Horse Nine (#1 Italian 4.25, #2 Int'l 4.15, Screenplay/GL contender) 0.07. Ceremony runs Sat Sep 12 evening.
